newsitem.title: USA: Cayman Water holder gets okay to up stake.
newsitem.headline: Cayman Water holder gets okay to up stake.

text.p: Argyle Partners Ltd said on Wednesday it received approval from the Cayman Islands government to acquire up to a 50 percent stake in Cayman Water Co.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Texas limited partnership said it got the okay on July 22. It currently holds a 9.65 percent stake, or 283,570 common shares, in the water company.

In the SEC filing, Argyle said that if it elects to proceed with its efforts to acquire up to a 50 percent stake in Cayman Water, it will seek to remove the current chairman and chief executive officer and replace him with a suitable person from the Cayman Islands as chairman and an Argyle partner as chief executive.
Argyle also said it would seek to remove all the current directors except four and hire new accountants, legal counsel and bankers.
It also said it would apply to list the company's common shares on the Cayman Stock Exchange.
